name: Jeong Jin-woon
bio: Jung Jin-woon (정진운) is a South Korean singer and actor.  He is a member of boyband 2AM.

credits.overview: A man unexpectedly meets his first love — a woman who died in a car accident three years earlier. Realising the past and present have become intertwined, he takes her on an impossible journey across Mongolia.
